title: Neon Pulse (Cyberpunk Etude)
prompt_override: Direct a kinetic Neon Cyber-Dancer on a rain-slicked holographic rooftop. Sync robotic step-grooves to the 128 BPM arpeggio, build tension with spinning charge rings during the riser, and trigger high-voltage shockwave leaps on the drop.

score.title: Neon Pulse (Cyberpunk Etude)
score.director_summary: A high-energy cyberpunk performance where Kaelen Vex, a neon-clad android dancer, locks into a 129 BPM synth arpeggio on a rain-slicked holographic rooftop. The choreography progresses from precise robotic isolation steps during the muted arpeggio intro, winds up through a high-frequency snare and pitch-riser buildup, and explodes into anti-gravity shockwave leaps and rapid spins when the full sub-bass and saw-lead drop at 16.6s, before powering down into a glowing stasis pose as the synth echoes fade.

character.name: Kaelen Vex, the Neon Cyber-Dancer
character.concept: An agile, street-smart android street dancer with articulated carbon-fiber joints and sound-reactive LED circuitry embedded in a cropped tech-jacket, performing atop a rain-swept cyberpunk skyscraper.
character.style: High-contrast cyberpunk vector anime with glowing neon rim-lighting, chromatic aberration accents, and wet rooftop reflections.

sections.name: Arpeggio Boot-Up & Snare Ignition
sections.background: Dark rain-slicked holographic rooftop with a dim cyan wireframe grid pulsing to the muted synth arpeggio

sections.name: High-Voltage Riser & Charge Sequence
sections.background: Vertigo-inducing neon sky-billboards flickering rapidly in magenta and yellow as energy conduits surge upward

sections.name: Overdrive Cyber-Drop Climax
sections.background: Full-spectrum holographic cityscape overload with shockwave ripples expanding across the wet rooftop floor on every beat

sections.name: System Cooldown & Neon Fade
sections.background: Mist-shrouded cyberpunk skyline settling into deep violet twilight as lingering digital rain drifts down

events.why: As the clean 129 BPM synth arpeggio establishes its foundational pulse, Kaelen executes a crisp robotic isolation step to the left, locking his glowing sneakers into the grid.
On the second four-bar arpeggio cycle, Kaelen mirrors his mechanical groove with a sharp step right, sending a cyan ripple across the wet rooftop surface.
Sharp electronic snare hits suddenly enter the mix and begin climbing in pitch; Kaelen drops his center of gravity into a sharp hydraulic bounce to absorb the sudden rhythmic impact.
As the quarter-note snare strikes reach peak transient force, Kaelen thrusts both arms skyward to summon twin holographic charge rings around his wrists.
The snare roll doubles its speed at the maximum onset peak of the track (1.000), propelling Kaelen into a high-velocity vortex spin that trails ribbons of magenta plasma.
During the frantic 16th-note snare acceleration and rising synth sweep, Kaelen locks into an overhead power-charge stance as sparks arc across his visor.

With the main drop in full swing, the piercing synth lead hits its upper-register hook and sub-bass pulse; Kaelen launches into an anti-gravity shockwave leap that shatters the holographic floor grid.
At the midpoint turnaround of the drop melody, Kaelen whips into a razor-sharp 360-degree cyber-spin, synchronizing with the bright synth syncopation.
As the lead synth makes its final climactic ascent before the outro, Kaelen executes one last high-voltage leap with maximum neon bloom and camera zoom.
The driving beat cuts out abruptly, leaving only soft, bell-like synth arpeggio echoes; Kaelen freezes in an iconic silhouette pose as his LED circuits slowly dim into standby mode.

climax.description: Following the intense snare roll and pitch-riser buildup, the track erupts at 16.6s into its highest sustained energy section (0.49 avg energy) featuring a soaring high-octave synth lead over a driving four-on-the-floor bassline. Kaelen unleashes his full aerial vocabulary—leaping and spinning in sync with the melodic peaks.
climax.visual_boost: Dual cyan-magenta shockwave rings on beat + 1.3x dynamic camera zoom + intense neon visor bloom and rain-splash particle overdrive
